description: Source code for handling user status and custom status API endpoints in Mattermost, including functions for getting, updating, and removing user statuses and custom statuses.

methods.name: InitStatus
methods.description: Initializes API routes for user status and custom status management.

methods.name: getUserStatus
methods.description: Handles retrieving a single user's status based on user ID.

methods.name: getUserStatusesByIds
methods.description: Handles retrieving multiple user statuses by a list of user IDs.

methods.name: updateUserStatus
methods.description: Handles updating a user's status, including permission checks and auto-responder management.

methods.name: updateUserCustomStatus
methods.description: Handles setting a custom status for a user, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: removeUserCustomStatus
methods.description: Handles removing a user's custom status, with permission checks.

methods.name: removeUserRecentCustomStatus
methods.description: Handles removing a user's recent custom status, with permission checks.
